_comment: Spoken-style questions. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it contains every phrase in must_contain (case and whitespace insensitive). For the end-to-end run, an answer is correct when it contains at least one alternative from every group in answer_facts and none of must_not (a contradiction of the manual). out_of_scope questions must be refused.

in_scope.q: how much leakage is okay on the pump packing
how often do the pump bearings need lubricating
what happens if I put too much grease in the bearings
what's the difference between NPSHA and NPSHR
how far can we trim down an impeller
what is a pony pump used for
what happens if all the valves after a positive displacement pump are closed
how do I check the mechanical seal during maintenance
how do I check the motor condition
why does running at low flow damage the impeller
must_contain: Internal recirculation tends to occur at low flow rates

in_scope.q: what is the best efficiency point of a pump
should I start the centrifugal pump with the discharge valves closed
must_contain: starting a centrifugal pump while it is deadheaded

in_scope.q: what's wrong with using a bypass valve to control flow
must_contain: power used to pump the bypassed fluid is wasted

in_scope.q: what should the piping look like right before the pump inlet
must_contain: straight run of pipe leads into the pump inlet

in_scope.q: what are wear rings for
must_contain: Wear rings are used in centrifugal pumps to establish clearances

in_scope.q: how can I tell if a pump is oversized
must_contain: five common indications that a pump is oversized

in_scope.q: which type of adjustable speed drive is most common
must_contain: VFDs are by far the most popular type of ASD

in_scope.q: why does the fluid boil inside the pump
must_contain: changing from a liquid to a vapor

in_scope.q: what is static head
must_contain: Static head is the pressure of the fluid in the system

in_scope.q: what do the affinity laws describe
must_contain: A set of relationships that tie together pump performance characteristics

in_scope.q: how do I know if a bearing is worn
must_contain: listening for noises that indicate excessive wear
